detail: SHIP-BLOCKER examples/platformer/src/render/PixiStage.tsx:28-32 assigns app before awaiting loadTextures. If unmount/HMR occurs during that await, cleanup destroys the Application and nulls its stage/renderer; the cancelled continuation then calls application.destroy(true) a second time, which throws while destroying the null stage. Centralize teardown behind an idempotent owner and fully destroy children/textures once.
